text: Teaching Objectives After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. Graduates will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies. Main Courses The duration of study is four years. The degree courses are: Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese, Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction. Please click here to download the timetable of subjects Diploma Awarded The qualified students will be awarded the Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design.
